description: Angular component for a time history selector with playback controls, handling time range, playback speed, and anchor points.

classes.name: HistorySelectorComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a time history selector with playback controls, time range management, and anchor point navigation.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles updates to input properties, recalculating maxTimeIndex and setting currentTime.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts the playback interval, emitting current time updates at specified speed.

methods.name: reInit
methods.description: Reinitializes the interval, restarting playback if active.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback and emits the current time.

methods.name: moveNext
methods.description: Advances to the next time point, considering anchors if enabled.

methods.name: movePrev
methods.description: Moves to the previous time point, considering anchors if enabled.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the closest anchor point greater than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: moveStart
methods.description: Moves to the start of the time range.

methods.name: moveEnd
methods.description: Moves to the end of the time range.

methods.name: changeIndex
methods.description: Changes the current index and updates currentTime accordingly.
